one_liner: Snowflake offers a SQL REST API plus a broad OpenAPI-described REST resource API, authenticated via OAuth or key-pair JWT. The pages show only a trial-account path, and each customer needs per-account setup.
auth_notes: The SQL API docs say to use OAuth or Key Pair. The REST API getting-started page uses a self-minted JWT as a bearer token (OTHER). Programmatic access tokens (PATs) are not confirmed by the pages, so API_KEY was dropped. Each customer has their own account URL.
access_notes: The docs home page links "Getting a Trial Account". The pages do not describe trial limits or ongoing billing.
blocker_notes: The pages show only a trial account as the entry path. Each customer also needs their own account URL and OAuth or key-pair setup. The MCP status rests on the registry hint only (io.github.Snowflake-Labs/mcp); no page covers it.
